column1: # Slop patterns shared by plugin/scripts/stop-check.sh (Python re) and src-tauri/src/run/slop.rs (Rust regex).
# Columns, tab separated: id, scope, pattern, message. A pattern must compile in both engines (no look-around).
# Scope: `*` every text file; `code` every file except docs (.md .mdx .txt .rst); `ext:a,b` those extensions (case-insensitive),
# optionally `@prefix/` to restrict to a folder. Only lines the change added are matched.
# Excluded paths: this file, fixtures/slop/, plugin/bmad/ (vendored) and lock files.
